scope: Discard Display Apply/clear/load responses after observed disconnect or device selection generation changes

verification.static_review: Generation checks cover success and errors; draft edits remain separate from submitted snapshot; no auto-retry added

assertions: Apply accepted before disconnect does not resend or apply subsequent unsent draft
Clear accepted before disconnect remains cleared despite late success/error
Load result from previous connection does not replace current draft
Late error/success does not publish obsolete status
Explicit readback obtains applied theme or reports no active theme after clear
limits: New fault cases use browser invoke fixture; native run is existing regression suite, not new Apply/clear/load interruption injection
Profile mutation interruptions and native replacement/cancellation barriers remain open
